The 2026 Breakdown:

🔹 QRPh Goes On-Chain: @coinsph integrates USDT/USDC directly into the national QRPh framework. Users can scan and spend stablecoins at 700,000 retail terminals with instant automated checkout conversion

Source: @BusinessInsider 

🔹 Maya x Lydian: Moving quickly on May 6, neobank giant @mayaofficialph  partners with Lydian to launch merchant crypto acceptance across POS, links, and codes with same-day PHP settlement

🔹 @Meta  Creator Payouts: Local @facebook  and @instagram  creators are receiving direct earnings in USDC over @solana  and @0xPolygon  networks via @stripe 

Source: @FortuneMagazine 

🔹 BSP Sovereign Rails: The Central Bank continues its domestic peso stablecoin pilot alongside bilateral CBDC development agreements with the UAE. 🏛️⛓

Source: @TheBanker

LOOK: Members of PISTON hold a protest mobilization outside the temporary central office of the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board along Kalayaan Avenue in Quezon City on Monday, May 18, during the hearing on the group’s petition for a fare hike.

The transport group urged the government to immediately approve the increase, citing soaring fuel prices and the rising cost of daily operations affecting public utility jeepney drivers.

📷: John Louie Abrina | MB
